rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Chunk 4 L26 'You paint by choosing the brush.' resolves via 'Context is king' in the same chunk. Debrief L43 'your rules file ... at the close of the exercise' is a session artifact / module-arc reference. Harm (reader cannot tell what a pronoun points at) absent: every demonstrative has a named antecedent in the sequential read.

Closest: L22 'The build-and-verify homework gave you a small system' names the source by title (navigational). Borrowed slides: 'every useful thing in this training' is deck-internal. grep -ciE 'opening lecture|lecture said' on expanded view -> 0 outside the prompt fences. rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Borrowed chunk 6 'Same question, two answers' (raw L28 include, lectures/context-is-king.md#same-question-two-answers): the outcome ('Claude suggests something Finnish: salmon, rye bread, meatballs.') is narrated before the cue 'Before you watch the second session run, take a guess. What will it suggest?' = reveal precedes guess (rule 4 first failure), and the cue points at a live session. FIT HERE: this module is self-study (L22 'This bonus module is self-study'), no trainer demo is stated in the body (only the maintainer Charge note 'the demo carries the time'), so a solo reader has no second session to watch and the beat has no referent. Harm (guess cue after the answer / aimed at a screen the reader lacks) is present. The wording defect itself is the home file's, reported in notes; the REVISE is the unresolved fit of the borrowed slide in a solo deck.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: In this deck either state who runs the two windows (trainer demo, or the reader opens two chats), or borrow without the guess cue; fix the order at home.

Closest: borrowed 'A file it reads every time' - header promises a file read every conversation, body delivers 'a file the agent reads at the start of every conversation'. You told it who you are' is a single negation then a positive claim; L36 'Not a checklist; a stance' is one contrast); no anaphora triple (closest 'A fact. A role. A preference. A constraint.' is a concrete enumeration, and 'Heart-healthy. Low-sodium. Vegetable-forward.' are concrete outputs); no self-grading superlative (closest L91 'great output' describes the participant's artifact); no number+retraction; no abstraction-noun stack; no empty verb triplet.
